role: read-only training diagnostics; no fit or prediction acceptance gate
boundary_interpretation: C=tr(J)/2 I-J is the physical second moment. A small positive C eigenvalue means the unconstrained log chart approaches the planar-body boundary; it is not set to zero. Vanishing sensitivity of that chart is distinct from an additional structurally unobservable physical parameter.
direct_physical_coordinates: five Frobenius-orthonormal trace-free symmetric inertia perturbations in kg m^2; CoG xyz in m; four log force effectiveness coordinates; log thrust tau
direct_physical_spectrum_caution: Mixed coordinate units; not a unit-independent condition-number. Full local rank does not establish global identifiability or calibrated uncertainty.
covariance_caution: Log-chart Gauss-Newton support covariance is only local curvature. Near a physical inertia boundary it is not a reliable Gaussian physical posterior; a discarded numerical chart direction must not be interpreted as certain. No parameter covariance is used for the angular-rate comparison bands.
force_scope: Rotational equation only: translational force balance and mass are not fitted. Effectiveness is an effective rotational calibration in the fixed nominal trace(J) scale gauge, not independently recovered thrust calibration.
